about: Privacy defects planted in examples/account-app/faulty by scripts/examples/plant_account_app.py. scripts/check-privacy.mjs --expected scores the entries of "defects". kind: code = check-privacy.mjs is designed to find it; runtime = needs an interaction the checker does not perform; human = needs a person. Defects that no checker rule covers are listed in "not_scored" with rule null, because the --expected loader requires a rule string.

defects.summary: A product analytics library is loaded on the home page before any choice.
defects.fixed_by: Audience measurement is declared with type="text/plain" and data-consent-purpose="analytics"; no other analytics library is loaded.

defects.summary: A web font is loaded from a third-party font service, which receives the visitor's IP address on every page view.
defects.fixed_by: The site uses system fonts; a web font would be self-hosted.

defects.summary: An advertising conversion tag is loaded on the sign-up page before consent.
defects.fixed_by: No advertising tag; any conversion measurement would be a declared purpose activated by the consent loader.

defects.summary: The footer of this page has no "Manage cookies" control, so a visitor who accepted cannot withdraw consent from here.
defects.fixed_by: Every page has the "Manage cookies" button in its footer.

defects.summary: A session replay script records the account page, which shows the member's personal data, before consent.
defects.fixed_by: No session replay tool is used.

defects.summary: A first-party script writes a persistent device identifier to localStorage before consent; it is not declared and serves no exempt purpose.
defects.fixed_by: Nothing is written on load except the session cookie, declared exempt in compliance/trackers.json.

defects.summary: "Refuse" is a small grey link under the "Accept all" and "Customise" buttons, so refusing is less visible than accepting.
defects.fixed_by: "Refuse all" is a button of the same size, colours and font as "Accept all", next to it.

defects.summary: The support chat widget, run by an external help-desk provider that sets trackers, is loaded with the page instead of after consent.
defects.fixed_by: The chat script keeps type="text/plain" and data-consent-purpose="chat"; without consent the page gives an email address.

not_scored.summary: The newsletter box of the sign-up form is ticked in advance, so subscribing is not an unambiguous act of the member.
not_scored.fixed_by: The newsletter box is unticked; the member ticks it to subscribe.
